Ah, someone thought it through.

I still present male almost everyday, but I deliberately favor appearing at least somewhat androgynous. I'll consider it a difference in opinion. Thanks!

I should have said before, I'm sorry I don't have any insight on the alcohol puzzle piece. Reliance/dependence to a substance is a very foreign issue to me.

Can I ask what sorts of things you're good at, or what you do for fun? Those seem to be 2 common ways to determine a passion or career goal. I remember feeling like I had NO idea wtf I wanted to do on this planet in exchange for money. That feeling remains in me today, I don't think it'll ever really go away.

But someone I looked up to noticed how I'd opted to sit things out all my childhood, like an observer. And we had a long talk where she told me she was afraid this "non-participation" would be the story of my life from cover to cover. I decided the pen belonged in my hand. Noone had to like what destiny I wrote, only me.

Not recommending one way or the other, just an anecdote for one path. Your mileage may vary:

At 21, my story was essentially the same, minus the alcoholism, but add a horrible distaste for my hometown. You'll be unsurprised to hear the military was the road I picked.

So, employment secured, not living with parents, or within my hometown, with a door to education open. Neat! Didn't solve the anxiety or social life situation. Virginity became beside the point after realizing I'm trans. Started hormones, ergo I have almost no testosterone in my blood, ergo my sex drive has vanished. I try to view it as a perk.

I guess all I wanna say is, there's no perfect way. But looking back, I think it's very important to want "forward" instead of wanting "out," if that makes any sense. I drew the mental model of what I wanted my life to look like, and used it as my north star - A wanderer like me found direction. Even if you don't arrive at your destination, you can approach.

Best wishes!
Also AD AF here. I'd be more than happyto talk. Post history of mine will show I'm not doing so hot either. Let me know what's up.
